answers: design finding 1: done — Added DSPRB-5[code] to cover the "probe runs once when the file loads" aspect of RQPRO-1 that DSPRB-1 did not reach. DSPRB-5 checks that the sed probe module variable is non-empty immediately after sourcing `scripts/lib/compat.sh`, before any call to `zbuild_sed_inplace`. A non-empty probe variable at load time proves the probe ran at source time rather than per-call. RQPRO-1 has two independently testable behaviors (not from a platform name; runs once at load), so it correctly gets two SPECs: DSPRB-1 covers the "wrong platform still works" behavior, DSPRB-5 covers the "set at load time" behavior.
